content: Dɑfidi u kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ
Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ nɑ Dɑfidin mi Heboroniɔ. Mɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɛsɛ kɑ wunɛ, sɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɛm tem.

Bɑɑ yellun di, sɑɑ ye Sɔɔlu u sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn sunɔ, wunɑ ɑ rɑ sun mɛnnɛ ɑ sun kpɑrɑ ɑ kɑ tɑbu dɑ, kpɑ ɑ kɑ mɑɑ sun wurɑmɑ. Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u mɑɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ kɑɑ ko bɛsɛn wiruɡii kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛ win tɔmbu kpɑrɑ.

Yerɑ Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu kpuro bɑ nɑ Dɑfidi sinɑ bokon mi Heboroniɔ. Mɑ u kɑ bu ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ Heboroni mi. Yerɑ bɑ nùn ɡum tɑ̃re wirɔ, bɑ nùn kuɑ be, Isirelibɑn sunɔ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ sɑɑ Sɑmuɛlin nɔɔn di.
Dɑfidi u Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri
u mwɑ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Dɑfidi kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wɔri. Yerusɑlɛmu yerɑ bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Yebusi. Miyɑ Yebusibɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ bɛɛ, n ǹ koorɔ u duumɑ wuu ɡe sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ Dɑfidi u bu wɔri u ben wuu ɡbɑ̃rɑruɡuu ɡe mwɑ. N deemɑ ɡerɑ bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Siɔni. Yen biru bɑ ɡu sokɑ Dɑfidin wuu.
N deemɑ Dɑfidi u rɑɑ win tɑbu kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wi u ɡbiɑ u Yebusibɑ wɔri u kɑmiɑ, yɛ̃rowɑ u koo ko tɑbu kowobun wiruɡii. Mɑ Yoɑbu, Seruyɑn bii u ɡbiɑ u bu wɔri u kɑmiɑ. Mɑ u kuɑ wiruɡii.
Dɑfidi u dɑ u sinɑ wuu ɡbɑ̃rɑruɡuu ɡen mi. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ ɡu sokɑ Dɑfidin wuu.
Mɑ u bɑni kuɑ u kɑ ɡu sikerenɑ. U bɑnɑwɑ sɑɑ Milon di u kɑ sikerenɑ. Mɑ Yoɑbu u mɑɑ ɡen mi n tie sɔnwɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidin dɑm mu sosimɔ. Domi Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Dɑfidin tɑbu kowobu
Wee be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin tɑbu kowobun wiruɡibu. Be kɑ Isirelibɑ kpurowɑ bɑ nùn kuɑ sinɑ boko nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ win tɔmbun sɔ̃. Bɑ nùn mɛm nɔɔwɑwɑ mɑm mɑm win bɑndun wɑɑti ye kpuro sɔɔ.
Yɑsobeɑmu, Hɑkumɔnin bii u sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu kowobun wiruɡii ben turo. Wiyɑ u tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) ɡo kɑ yɑɑsɑ nɔn teerun tɑbu sɔɔ.
Yen biru Eleɑsɑɑ, Dodon bii, Akosiɡii, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu kowobu itɑ yen turo.
U wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Dɑfidi Pɑsi Dɑmimuɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ Filisitibɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bu kɑ bu tɑbu wɔri. Mɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ duki Filisitibɑn wuswɑɑn di. N deemɑ ɡberu ɡɑrɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, tè sɔɔ bɑ ɔɔsu duurɑ.
Yerɑ Eleɑsɑɑ kɑ win tɔmbu bɑ yɔ̃rɑ ɡbee ten suunu sɔɔ bɑ kɑ tu yinɑ. Mɑ bɑ kɑ Filisitibɑ tɑbu kuɑ bɑ bu ɡo. Yinni Gusunɔ u bu nɑsɑrɑ bɑkɑ wɛ̃ dɔmɑ te.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Dɑfidin tɑbu sinɑmbu tɛnɑ ye sɔɔ, ben itɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ nùn deemɑ Adulɑmun kpee wɔruɔ, sɑnɑm mɛ Filisitibɑn tɑbu kowobun wuuru ɡɑru tɑ nɑ tɑ ten sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Refɑbɑn wɔwɑɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ kpee wɔru ɡe sɔɔ, mɑ Filisitibɑn sɑnsɑni yɑ mɑɑ ɡire Bɛtelehɛmuɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Bɛtelehɛmun bɛkɛ kuɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u koo kɑ mɑn Bɛtelehɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔn dɔkɔn nim nɑɑwɑ n nɔ.
Yerɑ win tɑbu durɔbu itɑ be, bɑ dɑ bɑ Filisitibɑn sɑnsɑni ye wɔri kɑ dɑm bɑ Dɑfidi nim mɛ tɑkɑmɑ bɑ kɑ nɑ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ mu nɔrɑ. U kɑ mu yɑ̃kuru kuɑwɑ, u Yinni Gusunɔ yɑriɑ.

U nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u mɑn ɡbɑrɑ bu nɛɛ, nɛnɑ nɑ nim mɛ nɔrɑ. Domi mɛn sɔ̃nɑ tɔn beni bɑ ben wɑ̃ɑru kɑri bɔrie. Nim mɛ, mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ben yɛm mɛ mu koo rɑɑ yɑri. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u yinɑ u mu nɔ. Yenibɑ kpurowɑ Dɑfidin tɑbu kowobu itɑ be, bɑ kuɑ.
Abisɑi, Yoɑbun wɔnɔwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ tɑbu sinɑmbu tɛnɑ yen wiruɡii. Tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbuwɑ (300) u ɡo kɑ win yɑɑsɑ. Mɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ wiɡibun suunu sɔɔ.
Bɑ nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ too. Adɑmɑ u ǹ tɑbu durɔbu itɑ be turɑ.

Bɛnɑyɑ, Kɑbisɛɛliɡii, Yehoyɑdɑn bii, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔ. Mɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ nɑsɑrɑ dɑbi te u wɑn sɔ̃. Wiyɑ u Mɔɑbubɑn tɔmbu yiru ɡɑbu ɡo, be bɑ sɛ̃ nɡe ɡbee sinɑnsu. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ duɑ dɔkɔ kpiriru sɔɔ u ɡbee sunɔ kɑ̃ɑsi mi, u ɡo purɑn sɑɑ sɔɔ.

Mɑ u Eɡibitin tɑbu durɔ dɑmɡii ɡoo ɡo. Win ɡunum mu sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔɔbu. Mɑ u yɑɑsɑ nɛni. Yen buru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe weson dɛkɑ ye u rɑ beku yɑsɑ tɛ̃ke. Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ u nùn wɔrim dɔɔ, bokurɑ u nɛni. Ye u turɑ mi, mɑ u durɔ win yɑɑsɑ ye u nɛni mi wɔrɑ u kɑ nùn sɔkɑ u ɡo.
Yenibɑ kpurowɑ Bɛnɑyɑ Yehoyɑdɑn bii u kuɑ. Mɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ tɑbu kowobu tɛnɑ ye sɔɔ.
U bɛɛrɛ bɑkɑ wɑ Dɑfidin tɑbu durɔbu tɛnɑ ye sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ yɑ ǹ tɑbu durɔ ɡbiikobu itɑ beɡiɑ turɑ. Mɑ Dɑfidi u nùn kuɑ win tiin kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii.
Dɑfidin tɑbu kowo ben ɡɑbun yĩsɑ wee, Asɑɛli, Yoɑbun wɔnɔ, kɑ Ɛlikɑnɑni, Dodon bii, Bɛtelehɛmuɡii,
kɑ Sɑmɔti, Hɑroriɡii, kɑ Helɛsi, Pɑloniɡii,
kɑ Irɑ, Ikɛsin bii, Tekoɑɡii, kɑ Abiesɛɛ, Anɑtɔtuɡii,
kɑ Sibekɑi, Husɑɡii, kɑ Ilɑi, Akoɑsiɡii,
kɑ Mɑhɑrɑi, Nɛtofɑɡii, kɑ Helɛdi, Bɑɑnɑn bii, wi u mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Nɛtofɑɡii,
kɑ Itɑi, Ribɑin bii, Gibeɑɡii, ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn temɔ, kɑ Bɛnɑyɑ, Pirɑtoniɡii,
kɑ Hurɑi, Nɑsɑle Gɑɑsiɡii, kɑ Abiɛli, Arɑbɑɡii,
kɑ Asimɑfɛti, Bɑsɑrumuɡii, kɑ Eliɑbɑ, Sɑɑboniɡii,
kɑ Bɛnɛ Hɑsɛmu, Gisoniɡii, kɑ Yonɑtɑm, Sɑɡen bii, Hɑrɑriɡii,
kɑ Akiɑmu, Sɑkɑɑn bii, Hɑrɑriɡii, kɑ Elifɑli, Urun bii,
kɑ Hefɛɛ, Mɛkerɑɡii, kɑ Akiyɑ, Pɑloniɡii,
kɑ Hɛsiro, Kɑɑmɛliɡii, kɑ Nɑɑrɑi, Ɛsibɑin bii,
kɑ Yoɛli, Nɑtɑnin mɔɔ, kɑ Mibisɑɑ, Hɑɡirin bii,
kɑ Selɛki, Amɔniɡii, kɑ Nɑkɑrɑi, Berɔtuɡii wi u rɑ Yoɑbu, Seruyɑn biin tɑbu yɑ̃nu sɔbe,
kɑ Irɑ, kɑ Gɑrɛbu be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yetɛɛbɑ,
kɑ Uri, Hɛti, kɑ Sɑbɑdi, Alɑiɡii,
kɑ Adinɑ, Sisɑn bii, Rubɛnin bwese kɛrɑn wiruɡii turo, wi u tɑbu kowobu tɛnɑ mɔ,
kɑ Hɑnɑni, Mɑɑkɑn bii, kɑ Yosɑfɑti, Mitiniɡii,
kɑ Osiɑsi, Asitɑrɔtuɡii, kɑ Sɑmɑ, kɑ Yeyɛli be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Hotɑmun bibu, Aroɛɛɡibu,
kɑ Yediɛli, Simurin bii, kɑ win wɔnɔ Yokɑ, Tisiɡii,
kɑ Eliɛli, Mɑkɑfimuɡii, kɑ Yeribɑi, kɑ Yosɑfiɑ, Elinɑmun bibu, kɑ Yitimɑ, Mɔɑbu,
kɑ Eliɛli, kɑ Obɛdi, kɑ Yɑsiɛli, Sobɑɡii.
Tɑbu kowo be bɑ kɑ Dɑfidi
nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ Sɔɔlun wɑɑti
